title: Employ staff under the Miscellaneous Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Miscellaneous Award 2020.

sources.title: Miscellaneous Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 Subject to clauses 4.2 , 4.3 , 4.4 and 4.5 this award covers employers throughout Australia and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 15 — Minimum rates who are not covered by any other modern award.

reach.condition: residual cover for employees in the award's classifications not covered by any other award; managers and professionals are excluded (cl 4.1, 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Safety-net award: it reaches employees no other award covers (cl 4.1).

assessment.summary: The Miscellaneous Award sets classifications, minimum pay and penalty rates for employees that no other award covers, other than managers and professionals.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
